question: Which of the following festivals is NOT related to agriculture?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Deepawali**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Diwali** is not **related to agriculture, while Lohri, Pongal, and Baisakhi are all harvest festivals.​**
 
• Diwali is the Hindu festival of lights.
 
• It is one of the most important and popular festivals in India, and is also celebrated by Hindus around the world.
 
• Diwali symbolizes the victory of light over darkness, good over evil, and knowledge over ignorance.</li&g
